changes.detail: Replaced commented-out single webServer entry with active array of two server entries: backend (port 3000, /v1/health) and frontend (port 4200)

ci_compliance.cross_directry_cd_handling: Each webServer entry uses 'cd <subdir> && <command>' per cross-directory-ci best practices
ci_compliance.reuse_existing_server: !process.env.CI allows local reuse, fresh start on CI
ci_compliance.health_check_endpoint: Backend uses /v1/health endpoint per devops-ci-cd-guardrails contract

deployment_readiness: E2E tests will now automatically start both backend (port 3000) and frontend (port 4200) before execution, with 60s timeout per service
